retrievers._source: plan rev3 A6: Li et al. 2024 use Contriever (version not stated; 'developed by Facebook'), FAISS inner product (MIPS) -> facebook/contriever main, contriever-msmarco sensitivity; settings as the P4 contriever-msmarco entry

corpora._source: plan rev3 sec.1: KB = MedRAG Textbooks (all 125,847); comparison corpora PubMed (6 shards, 90,692), Wikipedia (3 shards, 111,734 -> seeded random 90,692), MS MARCO (seeded random 90,692 passages of the rag_01 BEIR corpus; general corpus with a different style). Document text: MedRAG corpora use the records' own `contents` field ('title. content', MedRAG's convention; review 2026-10-06), MS MARCO title + ' ' + text (Li do not state their text construction)

queries._source: Li sec.4.1: MedQA-US (1,273) is the IK set of Textbooks; OoK = the 7 other datasets (TruthfulQA without the Health category = 762; WikiQA unique questions = 3,047; CommonsenseQA all splits = 12,102 here vs 12,247 in Li). Query text = question only (our choice; Li do not state it); question + options (MIRAGE datasets) as a reproduction sensitivity. queries whose source document is in a comparison corpus are excluded from the relative analysis (B/C), symmetrically (review 2026-10-06): PubMedQA / BioASQ gold PMIDs in the PubMed shards, WikiQA document_title and TruthfulQA Wikipedia source page in the Wikipedia subset (exact title match)

reproduction._source: Li et al. EMNLP 2024 sec.3.2 and sec.4.2 [원문 확인 2026-10-06]: test statistics MSS (-max sim), KNN (-k-th sim), AvgKNN (-mean top-k), Entropy (entropy of softmax over the top-k sims), Energy (-tau log sum_topk exp(s/tau), tau = 1); inner product; k = 32; 300 IK vs 300 OoK drawn at random, mean AUROC over 10 runs; Table 1(a) Textbooks values transcribed. Fisher / Simes omitted (their IK reference set for the eCDF is not specified)

relative.id_split: MedQA split once (seeded) into calibration and test halves; test half = ID negatives; calibration half = operating-point threshold (95% ID acceptance)
relative._source: plan rev3 A6 items 2-3 with our main protocol (cosine top-10 mean, S_tau grid, pooled mix) for comparability with A1-A5; also the Li-native pooled ratio on inner-product AvgKNN (k = 32): mixIP@a = AvgKNN_KB - a * AvgKNN_pool. RQ3 analogue: replacement design {MS MARCO + PubMed} vs {MS MARCO + Wikipedia} per OOD dataset; neighbour corpus per plan (research-type -> PubMed, general -> Wikipedia, exam-type -> none, control); the ID side is identical across OOD datasets for a given set, so the difference-in-differences across OOD types isolates the OOD-side neighbour effect. Query-level bootstrap (ID and OOD resampled independently, paired across scores)

rq3_designs._source: C1 replacement with MS MARCO as the shared member (plan); C2 direct swap without MS MARCO (review 2026-10-06: MS MARCO is itself a neighbour of web/Bing-style general datasets such as WikiQA). Both size-matched within the pair

relative.did_rule: fixed before the run (review 2026-10-06): a dataset enters the DiD only if its absolute AUROC and both arms' AUROC are < 1 - dprime_clip (no clipped cell); contrasts are also reported in AUROC; clipped cells are flagged per dataset. Interpretation caveat: PubMed as neighbour of PubMedQA/BioASQ is also a format/source-style match (PubMedQA questions are rephrased PubMed titles), Wikipedia is not format-matched to the general datasets
